entry.title: Opera introduces a new web standard to let users deploy AI locally in their browser
entry.summary: The new standard, WebAI, is designed to work with a variety of AI models.

entry.title: General Compute raises $100 million Series A, countering the neocloud disaster narrative
entry.summary: General Compute is betting on inference chips from outside the Nvidia ecosystem.

entry.title: Anduril, Qualcomm launch BlueChip, a new kind of US-made laptop
entry.summary: Anduril founder Palmer Luckey is vowing to bring computer manufacturing back to the U.S., and by that he doesn't just mean assembly, but every individual component, some of which are exclusively made in China today.

entry.title: Billionaire Palmer Luckey isn’t leaving California over the wealth tax
entry.summary: "It's causing a lot of people to run who I don't want to be running," native Californian Palmer Luckey said. "But I'm planning on staying in California. I'm going to keep fighting it."

entry.title: Japan internet giant GMO says hackers posted stolen customer data
entry.summary: Japan's GMO Internet is verifying alleged customer data posted by suspected hackers following a cloud service breach.

entry.title: Apple rolls out iOS 27.2 with new Siri AI languages and security fixes
entry.summary: The latest Apple software update for iPhones and iPads includes new features and important security updates.

entry.title: Apple unveils new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 chip
entry.summary: The new MacBook Pro comes with 24 hours of battery life, and now features support for Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 connectivity.

entry.title: US government says hackers are now exploiting critical PHP web bugs
entry.summary: The U.S. government cyber agency warns that hackers have figured out a way to exploit the popular PHP software, used in 70% of the web's software.

entry.title: Ford Fathom will be the cheapest American EV capable of powering a house
entry.summary: Ford is rolling out two new chargers capable of powering a home or the grid — so-called V2X capability.

entry.title: Meta AI director Rohit Patel leaves to take on Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
entry.summary: Rohit Patel is departing Meta after eight years working on AI evaluations and reinforcement learning, TechCrunch has exclusively learned. His startup, Ndoc, aims to take on Microsoft Office Suite.

entry.title: Google’s Genie 4 world model adds audio, more realistic worlds, and real-time steering
entry.summary: Genie 4 can maintain a consistent scene for up to two minutes, double Genie 3's limit, and offers better physics and more humanlike characters.

entry.title: Frontier AI labs say their models refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis. What does that mean?
entry.summary: TechCrunch spoke to the MIT computer scientist charged with explaining OpenAI's latest mind-bending discovery.

entry.title: Disruptive raises $10B fund to make big bets on at least 10 companies
entry.summary: Disruptive has made headlines in recent years for pouring money into companies like chip startup Groq and the AI voice-generation startup ElevenLabs.

entry.title: Re:Build, which spun out Slate Auto, raises $2.1B
entry.summary: The manufacturing accelerator bills itself as "America’s answer to Shenzhen."

entry.title: Discord is making its public communities more searchable, and people have concerns
entry.summary: In December, messages from Discord's public discoverable servers will begin appearing in search engine results.

entry.title: Who’s really in charge at Anthropic after the IPO?
entry.summary: Here's a clear explanation of Anthropic's incredibly complex governance structure.

entry.title: Bank of America kindly asks that you don’t share your banking password with your AI assistant
entry.summary: The banking giant reminds customers that "you're responsible for activity" resulting from your AI agents' access.

entry.title: GM is embracing hybrids now
entry.summary: GM eschewed hybrids in favor of battery-electric vehicles. Now it's gearing up to offer hybrid versions of its SUVs.

entry.title: From 8VC to Benchmark, here’s what’s hiding in October SEC filings
entry.summary: A whole crop of venture capital firms are raising significant new funds.

entry.title: Guidewire buys Hyperexponential for $1.7B in cash
entry.summary: The deal, expected to close sometime next year, is to help bring AI agents to work alongside humans to underwrite, analyze, and price decisions.
